Wi-Fi help in Lowell, MA

Route 3 Tech provides calm, practical Wi-Fi and home network help for Lowell, Chelmsford, Burlington, and Nashua. If your connection is unreliable, slow, or full of dead zones, I can get it stable and keep it that way.

This service is designed for homeowners and small offices along the Route 3 corridor who want clear answers and a fix that sticks. You will get a focused visit that identifies the cause, tightens up the setup, and leaves you with simple guidance.

Flat-rate visit with up to 2 hours in person

The Wi-Fi and home network fix is a flat rate that includes up to 2 hours in person. That time is used to troubleshoot signal quality, device behavior, router settings, and layout, with no surprise add-ons.

  • Signal and speed checks in the areas that matter most
  • Router and access point placement recommendations
  • Security updates and sane settings for your household
  • Clear notes on what changed and how to keep it stable

Common Wi-Fi problems I fix

  • Dead zones on the second floor or at the far end of the house
  • Video calls that freeze or drop at the worst time
  • Smart TVs and streaming devices that lose their connection
  • Slow speeds even with a modern internet plan
  • Interference from neighbors or older equipment

When upgrades are worth considering

If the equipment is very old or the home layout is challenging, a newer router or mesh system can make a big difference. I will explain what the current gear can realistically do, then outline a couple of options that fit your space and budget. You can decide whether to keep the existing setup or move to something more reliable.

What to expect from intake to follow-up

  1. Quick intake

    Share the symptoms, your town, and what devices matter most. Text or email is fine.

  2. On-site visit

    I test signal quality, confirm root causes, and make practical adjustments within the 2-hour window.

  3. Simple wrap-up

    You get clear notes on changes, plus suggestions if hardware limits the result.

  4. Follow-up support

    Seven-day follow-up by text and a short remote check-in if something needs to be tuned.
